objective.text: Trial arm 0, stage 0: current workflow (parallel two-arm review, current Larrey level, current coordination) on 30 seed-drawn claim-ready decided-YES orders, giving the baseline filed dossiers and list-price cost per filed claim for the Junto lean two-arm test.

premortem.failure: The draw is not disjoint or not matched, so the arms differ by order mix
premortem.guard: lean_draw.py draws both arms from one pool by seed, asserts disjointness and records pool and list hashes in DRAW.json before either arm runs

premortem.failure: The batch overruns its cap with repairs and reviewer sessions
premortem.guard: --batch-usd 45 on the conveyor, which stops launching when spend plus in-flight forecast would pass it; the owner reads the status line between arms

premortem.failure: A review set misses a planted control
premortem.guard: controls are planted in every review set; any miss ends the trial and keeps arm 0 under the stop rule

acknowledged_findings.F-20261113-conveyor-audit: MEASURES.json records requests and per-request prompt size, cache reads and writes for each arm, and the trial compares both arms at request level, not on summed tokens alone.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261110-mommsen-unranked-pools: One Bentham-ranked action only (production.claim_ready.yes.fr); claim-kit admission refuses orders outside it; stage 0 is one lane and 30 orders per arm.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261107-haloander-undecided-probe: No undecided orders: the draw pool contains only decided-YES claim-ready orders.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261109-gutenberg-carnot: Arm 1 is the measured lean-coordination arm this finding asked for; arm 0 is the unchanged comparison.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261118-kiaer-stopped-at-review: Every guard in the pre-mortem is code the conveyor runs; planted controls reach both review arms in both configurations, and the both-uphold rule is unchanged.
